instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: PropTech startup operating a platform for fractional real estate investment allowing retail investors to invest in commercial properties with as little as €100. The company manages over 15,000 registered investors and currently holds €25M in funded properties across various global markets. They are subject to strict oversight by the CMVM, requiring compliance with evolving real estate investment standards.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: We operate in a consolidating market where competitors are merging to gain economies of scale. Our independent position is increasingly vulnerable. We need to proactively strengthen our competitive positioning — either by deepening our specialization in high-margin niches where scale matters less, or by building platform-like switching costs that make our offering stickier for existing customers.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Automated Property Sourcing and Due Diligence Engine
opportunities.rationale: Given high competitive pressure and the need for market defense, developing an AI platform can radically reduce sourcing time and improve deal quality beyond current manual processes. This would create a significant switching cost for competitors who rely on slower, traditional methods.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional task force (tech/finance) to define MVP requirements.
Conduct pilot study comparing AI sourcing efficiency against current manual benchmarks.
resources_needed: Data science expertise or contract with specialized PropTech consultants
Dedicated engineering hours for proof-of-concept development
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in deal sourcing cycle time by 30% within 12 months.
milestones: Q3: Finalize technical specifications and vendor selection.
Q4: Launch closed beta with internal teams.

opportunities.title: Enhanced Digital Onboarding and CRM Integration
opportunities.rationale: Addressing the 'culture' barrier by providing a seamless, structured digital experience for investors. This incremental step improves internal process efficiency and directly addresses investor retention through better UX.

first_actions: Prioritize migration of core investor data from spreadsheets to a scalable CRM platform.
Design a standardized onboarding workflow across all business units.
resources_needed: Subscription fees for enterprise CRM software
Training budget for customer success teams
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in investor NPS score by 5 points within six months.
milestones: Month 1-2: Data migration and platform setup.
Month 3-4: Rollout to top two business units.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated 'Digital Transformation Steering Group' to align decentralized innovation efforts with the new CEO's mandate.
Conduct an internal audit of existing technology adoption barriers (e.g., tool compatibility, change management needs) to identify immediate cultural friction points.
Begin formal ROI modeling for the proposed AI Sourcing Engine pilot project using current budget allocations.

key_weaknesses: Informal innovation process leading to inconsistent tool adoption and high friction in change management.
Decentralized resource allocation limiting the scaling potential of successful pilot programs.
Reliance on legacy, manual project tracking methods which hinder data-driven decision making.
High competition and market consolidation creating immense pressure that current operational agility cannot handle.
